name: Starry Paradox
effects:
Instant ATB 1 & Diffusion Barrier 1 to user, Instant Cast
Master Mode: Cap Break Level 2, Hero Boost +25%, Zero SB Cost 1 & Instant SB/LB Cast 1
Interval Chase: 10 single-target Fire/NE, Ice/NE, Lightning/NE or Dark/NE magic attacks under En-Fire, En-Ice, En-Lightning or En-Dark + minor DeShell for 5 seconds, Hero Boost +30/35/40/45/50% to user after 1/2/3/4/5 chases (max 5 chases)
Master Chase: Single-target Fire/Ice/Lightning/Dark/NE magic attack at True Cap Break Level 1 + DeShell 30% for 5 seconds, Instant Cast 1 to user, removes Master Mode
